description: cited_path_changed: a cited file whose last commit is dated strictly after the entry's Verified date (inline or on its own line) is listed; an older last change, a change on the Verified day itself (day granularity), an entry without a Verified date, an untracked file are not. Only paths on the entry's Source line (its anchor) are checked: a changed path named only in Why sets no flag, and the same path on the Source line does. A date-shaped but invalid Verified value (2026-02-30, 2026-13-45) is treated as missing and named in errors[], never a crash. The repository is read with one batched git log from the oldest Verified date in the file (2026-07-01 here, so docs/b.md's 2026-08-01 commit is in that log); a tracked file named like a date (2026-12-31, committed with docs/b.md) is never read as a commit date. The flag is an input, not a trigger: memory_pass stays null; the entry is a suspect, counted per file in the index.
